suite: extensions/connector-claude-code/smoke/agui-start-source.smoke.ts plus the real-broker hook/emitter arm in agui-run-error.smoke.ts
guard: only a genuinely new Claude startup reads from byte zero, waits boundedly for a transcript path that SessionStart can precede, never replays retained history, and honors a recovered cursor
why: The first live failure was a skipped opener: Claude wrote a positional prompt before SessionStart,
then generic adopt-at-end parked after it. A live PR probe exposed the opposite edge: retaining
SessionStart let it beat creation of the transcript path, and one ENOENT terminally stopped the
emitter while the model and DMs worked.
Startup retries only that missing-file state, with capped backoff and a five-second monotonic
deadline that also bounds one stalled open/read attempt. Retained and recovered sources remain
strict. The suite grades delayed creation, bounded absence, a never-settling read, partial records,
promptless startup, retained modes, recovery, and unsupported source values.

mutations.name: S1 treat startup like a generic adopt, recreating the live skipped-run-opener defect
mutations.find:
case "startup":
      return new StartupClaudeTranscriptSource(file, opts.startupFileWaitMs ?? STARTUP_TRANSCRIPT_WAIT_MS);

mutations.name: S2 replay retained history by treating resume/fork/clear/compact as startup
mutations.find:
case "resume":
    case "fork":
    case "clear":
    case "compact":
      return file;
mutations.replace:
case "resume":
    case "fork":
    case "clear":
    case "compact":
      return new StartupClaudeTranscriptSource(file, opts.startupFileWaitMs ?? STARTUP_TRANSCRIPT_WAIT_MS);
mutations.note: Also reds the fork, clear and compact cells; the blast radius is four named retained-history checks.

mutations.name: S3 make the startup wrapper use generic adopt-at-end on a virgin cursor
S4 make the explicit core from-zero door silently adopt at the current end
mutations.note: The smoke resolves @cotal-ai/connector-core through dist, so this mutation builds the changed source before grading and rebuilds the restored source afterwards; otherwise a green measures stale dist, not this method.

mutations.name: S5 fail the emitter on the first pre-creation ENOENT instead of waiting for Claude
mutations.note: Recreates the live PR #933 probe: SessionStart reaches the source correctly, but Claude has not created its JSONL path yet.

mutations.name: S6 let one stalled file read outlive the advertised startup deadline
